paper_id: From Cloud to Edge_ A First Look at Public Edge Platforms
title: From Cloud to Edge: A First Look at Public Edge Platforms
motivation: 边缘计算的优势已定性知晓,但缺乏运营环境的定量特征刻画
problem_framing: 从用户视角和提供商视角首次对商业化公版边缘平台进行测量研究
key_insight: NEP的VM资源配置过度且利用率低,延迟关键应用仍无法满足,计费模型粗粒度是经济性隐患
method_signature: 众包网络测量+自建QoE应用+3个月VM workload追踪
evaluation_criteria: 端到端延迟/吞吐量/应用QoE/VM资源使用/ monetary cost
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: NEP仍无法满足云VR/AR(5-20ms)和自动驾驶(10ms)需求,吞吐量仅在>200Mbps时改善, billing model粗粒度
evidence_for_taste: we believe that throughput is not a primary advantage
existing resource allocation challenges are amplified
draw our conclusions in a conservative and cautious manner
only when we are confident that the disparities
this comparison is not perfectly apples-to-apples
has not generally sunk into cellular core networks as envisioned
thinking_moves: 首次测量研究建立新兴领域的定量基线
dual approach揭示边缘生态全貌
承认Azure对比的局限性并保守下结论
从定性已知反推定量未知的系统性空白
hop-level latency breakdown追溯瓶颈所在
